hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.back: PvP hits only land from behind, at double damage; frontal hits do nothing, not even knockback.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.vamp: Every point of damage you deal to any living thing comes back as health.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.bloo: At 3 hearts or less every hit you land is lethal; heal up and it stops.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.weap: Attacks within 3 s build heat: 2 weakness, 3 slowness, 4 severe overheat. A heat bar sits under the crosshair.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.stay: Runners get an unbreakable Sharpness 255 golden sword; cannot be dropped or picked up by hunters, removed when the card ends.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.frag: Everyone's max health drops to 3 hearts, restored proportionally afterwards.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.expl: A player dying or a mob being killed explodes on the spot.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.key_: Every hit shuffles move, jump, sneak and sprint keys; a top-right HUD shows the current layout.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.flas: Everyone gets Speed X: blindingly fast, barely steerable.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.shad: Hitting another player teleports them 1-4 blocks away; you struck an afterimage.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.hurt: Any damage teleports you 1-15 blocks in a random direction; lava is fair game.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.spac: Every %s s everyone in the same dimension is dealt a random position (possibly their own); the action bar counts down.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.port: Random pairs each get a one-shot portal (end gateway blocks) a few blocks away that leads to the partner's portal, friend or foe. An odd player joins a random pair. New batch every 60 s.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.pear: Hold up to %s pearls, +1 every %s s; throwing may backfire.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.wind: +1 wind charge every %s s, up to 16; blast strength %s.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.ligh: Light armor grants speed, heavy armor slowness.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.hung: Eat any food for an instant 10 s of Speed VI.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.stil: Stay put for over 1 s and you glow (red hunters, blue runners); moving stops it.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.snea: Hold sneak to become invisible and immune to damage; you cannot move, jump or attack meanwhile.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.hunt: Runners glow the whole time; they get a distance warning whenever a hunter comes within %s blocks.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.who_: Everyone becomes Steve, name tags hide, tab list and chat show "Player".
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.tiny: Everyone shrinks to about one block; camera and hitbox follow.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.worl: 30 s after the draw (action-bar countdown) gravity points in a random horizontal direction: you stop falling down and get pulled that way, and the view rolls 90 degrees to match. Ends with the card.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.supp: Every %s s chests fall at the midpoint between hunters and runners (one per runner, max 4); a beacon marks the spot the moment it is announced, 20 s before landing.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.drop: Anything thrown from your inventory explodes after 2 s: small blast, no block damage, dropped items are spared, and the item itself can be thrown again.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.chai: Breaking a block also clears the 3x3x3 ahead along your look direction with normal drops; only what your tool can harvest.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.bloc: Newly placed blocks disappear after %s s.
hunterwildcard.screen.wildcard_info.back: Everyone drops into the Backrooms maze for %s s: every 20 s both sides glow for 5 s (hunters red, runners blue). Fall through a false floor to get home; once a whole side is out everyone returns.
